subject: physics
note: IGCSE-only concepts (new notes) and the IGCSE spec points that join existing GCSE concepts. Merged with gcse-physics.json by conceptMap.ts. Each IGCSE spec point is primary in exactly one concept.

concepts.title: Measuring length, volume and time
concepts.scope: Choosing rulers, measuring cylinders, clocks and timers, and averaging multiples to find small distances and short intervals such as the period of a pendulum.

concepts.title: Drag and terminal velocity
concepts.scope: Friction (drag) on objects moving through liquids and gases, and how falling objects reach terminal velocity with and without air resistance.

concepts.title: Centre of gravity and stability
concepts.scope: What centre of gravity means, finding it for an irregular lamina with a plumb line, and how its position and the base width affect stability.

concepts.title: Thermal expansion
concepts.scope: How solids, liquids and gases expand when heated, everyday uses and problems of expansion, and the particle explanation of their different expansions.

concepts.title: Brownian motion
concepts.scope: Random motion of microscopic particles in a suspension, and how collisions with fast, light molecules explain it as evidence for the particle model.

concepts.title: Evaporation and cooling
concepts.scope: Evaporation as escape of energetic surface particles, how it differs from boiling, what affects its rate and why it cools a liquid and objects touching it.

concepts.title: Conduction and convection
concepts.scope: Thermal conduction in solids by lattice vibrations and free electrons, poor conduction in gases and liquids, convection currents, experiments, and everyday applications of heat transfer.

concepts.title: Diffraction of waves
concepts.scope: Waves spreading through a gap or round an edge, how wavelength and gap size change it, and showing it in a ripple tank.

concepts.title: Refractive index and optical fibres
concepts.scope: Refractive index as a ratio of speeds, n = sin i / sin r and n = 1 / sin c, and optical fibres in telecommunications.

concepts.title: Sound: pitch, loudness and speed
concepts.scope: How vibrating sources make sound, why it needs a medium, how frequency and amplitude set pitch and loudness, and why sound is fastest in solids.

concepts.title: Communication using electromagnetic waves
concepts.scope: Satellite and mobile communications by microwaves and other EM waves, and the difference between analogue and digital signals and the benefits of digital.

concepts.title: E.m.f. and potential dividers
concepts.scope: Electromotive force as work done per unit charge by a source, E = W/Q, combining e.m.f.s in series, and potential dividers with R1/R2 = V1/V2.

concepts.title: Earth, Sun and Moon
concepts.scope: How the Earth's rotation and tilt, its orbit of the Sun and the Moon's monthly orbit explain day and night, seasons and phases, and average orbital speed v = 2πr/T.

concepts.title: Elliptical orbits and planetary data
concepts.scope: Elliptical orbits with the Sun off-centre, why speed rises nearer the Sun, how gravity and orbital speed change with distance, and reading planetary data.

concepts.title: Light-years, galaxies and the Hubble constant
concepts.scope: Light travel times, light-years, galaxies, finding galaxy speed and distance, the Hubble constant H0 = v/d and the age of the Universe 1/H0.

concepts.title: Star colour, brightness and the HR diagram
concepts.scope: How a star's colour shows its surface temperature, how absolute magnitude measures brightness at a standard distance, and the main groups on a Hertzsprung-Russell diagram.
